title: Round 1 verdict for meadow-snapshot-pacing: loop on C1 and A1 through interphase amendment 1
context: Round 1 reviewed ef95801d (base 6b095878) with code-reviewer and conformance-auditor; the validator confirmed both candidates. pipeline.mjs verdict printed outcome loop with blockers C1 MEDIUM (meadow_rays.dart:80-90, recolour compares with the last requested colours instead of the current composite and never clears the stale mark, so a colour changed and changed back redraws an identical composite and spends one of the four renders a gap) and A1 HIGH (10.9 row 1, meadow_frame_free_build_test.dart:153-155 adds a settling pump the row does not give; run as given, pump 0 draws a frame scheduled by FocusManager.applyFocusChangesIfNeeded inside pumpWidget, not by the stage). C2 LOW (mutable _parts list in meadow_layers.dart) is advisory. The suite's one failure (tooling android_dump_rules) passed 3 of 3 at base and head and was judged a load flake. Separately, Windows diagnostics showed the built first build never runs frame-free under the perf harness (freeBatches 0, first scene 806-810 ms) because the harness's ready loop keeps a frame scheduled and _timerFired rechecks hasScheduledFrame; a variant without the recheck reached 509-530 ms. A frame-free ready wait (quietready) is being measured to tell whether the recheck matters in real use.
options: Loop: invoke interphase:bug to amend the original spec with round-1 verdict.json as the only concerns, MSP label meadow-snapshot-pacing-amend-1, built with amend-1.zsh on mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing
Fold the frame-free recheck question into amendment 1 as an extra concern
Treat A1 as a spec defect only and ship without amending
option_reasons: pipeline.md Loop back: an MSP whose outcome is loop amends the original spec with that round's verdict.json as the only concerns; both blockers are confirmed and fixable (C1 in code, A1 by amending the row's given or the test)

The amendment request may name only the round's verdict as concerns; the recheck is a device-criterion question (10.12) still being measured, and is decided separately once the frame-free ready wait results are in
A confirmed HIGH blocker cannot ship as green, and the verdict is loop, not stop
outcome: Loop. Interphase amendment 1 runs on the original spec with ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/review/round-1/meadow-snapshot-pacing.verdict.json as the only concerns, the MSP worktree ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/trees/meadow-snapshot-pacing as --repo, MSP label meadow-snapshot-pacing-amend-1; then amend-1.zsh plan-only, build, merge into mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing and review round 2 with previous_head ef95801d. Record in review/round-1/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md; rounds.md line appended.
